items.title: CSGP Q3 deep dive: Cost controls and product investments shape outlook amid slower bookings
items.summary: Real estate data provider CoStar Group (NASDAQ:CSGP) reported Q3 2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 14.1% year on year to $952 million. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $986 million, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.38 per share was 12% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: CoStar’s Q3 earnings call: our top 5 analyst questions
items.summary: CoStar's third quarter was marked by a negative market response, despite revenue and non-GAAP profit surpassing Wall Street's expectations. Management attributed the disconnect to slower-than-anticipated net new bookings, which they linked primarily to economic headwinds and a reduction in sales force capacity. items.title: CoStar Group (CSGP) Agrees To Acquire Vexcel Group
items.summary: CoStar Group (NasdaqGS: CSGP) agreed to acquire Vexcel Group, adding high resolution aerial imagery to its real estate data platform. The transaction is structured to feed tens of billions of additional data fields per property into CoStar's AI driven analytics tools. Vexcel's aerial and street level imagery is expected to support richer property search, valuation and risk assessment capabilities across CoStar's products.
